title: Agent Desktop Plus
blurb: One screen, WSS, assist, WEM on the desktop, and the desk the PDF will support.
summary: Plus is the agent's instrument. Voice, pop, text, and the schedule fail in different ways.

lessons.title: One screen is the product
objectives: Count extra windows as a defect
paragraphs: Agent Desktop Plus is described as a single screen so the agent can stay with the customer. The Engage page adds real-time transcription, AI Agent Assist, and case context on that screen. The same underlying technology is what the desktop page says you get from Plus or from a pre-built CRM adapter.
A design that needs five browser tabs is the problem Plus is published to remove. If your floor still alt-tabs, you have not deployed the product you named.

lessons.title: Plus adapters speak HTTPS and WSS
objectives: Separate voice from the pop channel
paragraphs: The technical requirements say Plus adapters use HTTPS and Secure WebSocket. If a proxy is in the path, it must support WSS. The PDF also says Five9 does not support TLS 1.1, and that browsers need TLS 1.2. Unencrypted API connections are refused.
A screen pop that fails while voice still works is often this path: the media is fine and the websocket is not. Do not replace the headset first.

lessons.title: WEM lives in the same desktop
objectives: Show the schedule on the desktop
paragraphs: The desktop page says Plus can show schedules, adherence, time-off requests, and evaluations without another app. CRM connectors can surface the same WFO actions inside Salesforce and the other named CRMs.
That is the staffing blend meeting the person: the agent can see that they are supposed to be on a break. A dialer that ignores the schedule will call it idle time.

lessons.title: Digital text can be blocked
objectives: Match dropped calls to power management
paragraphs: The technical requirements say some antivirus software, naming Avast as an example, can stop chat, social, or email text from loading. Voice can continue. The symptom is a blank digital pane, not a busy DNIS.
Efficiency Mode can also sleep a background tab and drop a live call. Digital and voice fail differently. Write the symptom before you pick the cause.

lessons.title: Headsets and the path under the desk
paragraphs: USB noise-canceling headsets are the recommendation. Analog is not supported. Wireless is discouraged above about ten active agents because of delay. Wired LAN is preferred. Wi-Fi is tolerated only when bandwidth holds. Satellite and cellular, including 5G, are not supported.

Agent Desktop Plus and the adapters are listed at 128 kbps for G.711, which the PDF says is the default codec. Agent Assist adds 12 kbps. CRM in the same session adds another 64 kbps in that table. A VPN adds 64 kbps. Latency to the data center should be under 150 ms one way.

lessons.title: The desktop review
objectives: Escalate one-way audio to the network track
paragraphs: A desktop review is short: one screen, WSS through the proxy, TLS 1.2, the schedule visible, text not blocked, USB headset, supported path, Efficiency Mode off, and the bandwidth rows added up. Each line is from the product page or the PDF.
If those pass and audio is still one-way, you are in NAT and firewall territory, which is the SIP track. The desktop is no longer the prime suspect.
